# A06 requests (browser agent, recipe learning)

None of these block A06.

## 1. A05 / lead: review the engine hooks in `server/forms/engine.ts`

A06 made five small changes in A05's engine (details in `reports/A06.md`): the no-form path continues to verification and submit after
the agent's `done` (engine re-verifies the agent's page via `agentIntended(page)`); the unverified path also covers `via: 'recipe'` and
requires a real submit as the final nav; `AbortError` from the agent is rethrown; `recordRecipe` skips agent runs; `shadowHook()` runs
after every verified adapter / generic / recipe run. Please keep them when touching the engine.

## 2. A11 / lead: e2e replay misses from agent attempts

Replicas the generic path cannot verify now get one agent turn, which in replay has no recording (`REPLAY_MISSING`, status `error`,
behaviour otherwise unchanged). If the miss list should stay empty, either pass `allowAgent: false` in those e2e stages or ask A06 to
author recordings for specific replicas (`A06_RECORD=1` with the oracle in `scripts/a06/oracle.ts`).

## 3. A10: extra fields available

The UI shapes in `web/src/api.ts` are matched exactly. Extra data the Learning screen can use: `coverage[]`, `learning`, `shadow`,
`injectionAttempts` on `/api/agent/metrics`; `GET /api/agent/runs`; `GET /api/agent/recipes/:id/shadow`; `POST /api/agent/jobs/run`.
